title: M3.1 GitHub Pages author human-gate deployment
purpose: Deploy the exact frozen M3.1 authoring candidate under /authoring/ while preserving the exact promoted learner root, so the required short desktop author-facing human gate can be performed.

The deployed authoring subtree is built from exact frozen M3.1 product HEAD 6fa1acc23999b5a0b9a0b7f375a12f19ecc4e4e2.
The deployment workflow re-runs the exact independent QA oracle from exact QA HEAD 6ff592af68e6cc95bd479911a09388293c5528f5 in a separate worktree.
QA changes relative to product are exactly the three QA-WP-021 owned files.
Product blobs remain byte-identical between product HEAD and QA HEAD.
The Pages authoring bundle is deterministic and contains exact pedagogical_quality.py bytes.
The learner root remains exactly 366412 bytes with the frozen SHA-256.
Deployment occurs only through the protected github-pages environment from main.
Live smoke proves learner root, /authoring/ and pages-evidence identity.
Deployment evidence explicitly states promotion=false and humanGateRequired=true.
No product merge, stable M3.1 promotion, M3.2, M3.3, Gate3, Gate4 or M4+ activation is performed.
